+// buildPayload builds a canonical, unambiguous encoding of taskID, actor, and
+// expiry (UTC unix nanoseconds), using length-prefixed fields so that no
+// delimiter character can create ambiguity.
+func buildPayload(taskID, actor string, expires time.Time) []byte {
+	taskBytes := []byte(taskID)
+	actorBytes := []byte(actor)
+
+	payload := make([]byte, 0, 4+len(taskBytes)+4+len(actorBytes)+8)
+
+	var lenBuf [4]byte
+	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(lenBuf[:], uint32(len(taskBytes)))
+	payload = append(payload, lenBuf[:]...)
+	payload = append(payload, taskBytes...)
+
+	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(lenBuf[:], uint32(len(actorBytes)))
+	payload = append(payload, lenBuf[:]...)
+	payload = append(payload, actorBytes...)
+
+	var expBuf [8]byte
+	binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(expBuf[:], uint64(expires.UTC().UnixNano()))
+	payload = append(payload, expBuf[:]...)
+
+	return payload
+}
+
+func parsePayload(payload []byte) (taskID, actor string, expires time.Time, err error) {
+	if len(payload) < 4 {
+		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("approval: malformed payload")
+	}
+	taskLen := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(payload[0:4])
+	offset := 4
+	if uint64(offset)+uint64(taskLen)+4 > uint64(len(payload)) {
+		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("approval: malformed payload")
+	}
+	taskID = string(payload[offset : offset+int(taskLen)])
+	offset += int(taskLen)
+
+	actorLen := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(payload[offset : offset+4])
+	offset += 4
+	if uint64(offset)+uint64(actorLen)+8 > uint64(len(payload)) {
+		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("approval: malformed payload")
+	}
+	actor = string(payload[offset : offset+int(actorLen)])
+	offset += int(actorLen)
+
+	if offset+8 != len(payload) {
+		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("approval: malformed payload")
+	}
+	nanos := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(payload[offset : offset+8])
+	expires = time.Unix(0, int64(nanos)).UTC()
+
+	return taskID, actor, expires, nil
+}
